verses.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.pt: Filhos, sede obedientes aos vossos pais no Senhor, porque isso é justo.
verses.en_web: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.en_bbe: Children, do what is ordered by your fathers and mothers in the Lord: for this is right.

verses.en: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verses.pt: Honra teu pai, e tua mãe (que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa);
verses.en_web: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to your father and mother (which is the first rule having a reward),

verses.en: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
verses.pt: para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra. Deuteronômio 5:16
verses.en_web: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: So that all may be well for you, and your life may be long on the earth.

verses.en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.pt: Pais, não provoqueis à ira os vossos filhos, mas criai-os na disciplina e correção do Senhor.
verses.en_web: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: And, you fathers, do not make your children angry: but give them training in the teaching and fear of the Lord.

verses.en: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
verses.pt: Servos, obedecei aos vossos senhores segundo a carne, com temor e tremor, em sinceridade do vosso coração, assim como a Cristo;
verses.en_web: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;
verses.en_bbe: Servants, do what is ordered by those who are your natural masters, having respect and fear for them, with all your heart, as to Christ;

verses.en: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.pt: não servindo somente quando vistos, como para agradar pessoas; mas sim, como servos de Cristo, fazendo de coração a vontade de Deus;
verses.en_web: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
verses.en_bbe: Not only under your master's eye, as pleasers of men; but as servants of Christ, doing the pleasure of God from the heart;

verses.en: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.pt: servindo de boa vontade como ao Senhor, e não aos pessoas.
verses.en_web: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;
verses.en_bbe: Doing your work readily, as to the Lord, and not to men:

verses.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
verses.pt: Pois sabeis que cada um receberá do Senhor todo o bem que fizer, seja servo, seja livre.
verses.en_web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
verses.en_bbe: In the knowledge that for every good thing anyone does, he will have his reward from the Lord, If he is a servant or if he is free.

verses.en: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.pt: Senhores, fazei o mesmo a eles, abandonando as ameaças, pois sabeis também que o Senhor vosso e deles está nos céus, e que com ele não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.en_web: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
verses.en_bbe: And, you masters, do the same things to them, not making use of violent words: in the knowledge that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he has no respect for a man's position.

verses.en: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.pt: Por fim, meus irmãos, fortalecei-vos no Senhor e na força do seu poder.
verses.en_web: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
verses.en_bbe: Lastly, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his power.

verses.en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.pt: Revesti-vos de toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais estar firmes contra as ciladas do diabo.
verses.en_web: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.en_bbe: Take up God's instruments of war, so that you may be able to keep your position against all the deceits of the Evil One.

verses.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verses.pt: Pois temos de lutar não contra carne e sangue, mas sim contra os domínios e poderes, contra os senhores das trevas deste mundo, contra os males espirituais nos lugares celestes.
verses.en_web: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
verses.en_bbe: For our fight is not against flesh and blood, but against authorities and powers, against the world-rulers of this dark night, against the spirits of evil in the heavens.

verses.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.pt: Portanto pegai toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais resistir no dia mal, e depois que fizerdes tudo, continuar firmes.
verses.en_web: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason take up all the arms of God, so that you may be able to be strong in the evil day, and, having done all, to keep your place.

verses.en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.pt: Estai, pois, firmes, com a vossa cintura envolvida com o cinturão da verdade, e vestidos com a couraça da justiça;
verses.en_web: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.en_bbe: Take your place, then, having your body clothed with the true word, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness;

verses.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.pt: e calçados os pés com a prontidão do evangelho da paz.
verses.en_web: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;
verses.en_bbe: Be ready with the good news of peace as shoes on your feet;

verses.en: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.pt: Sobretudo pegai o escudo da fé, com o qual podereis apagar todas as flechas inflamadas do maligno.
verses.en_web: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
verses.en_bbe: And most of all, using faith as a cover to keep off all the flaming arrows of the Evil One.

verses.en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
verses.pt: Pegai também o capacete da salvação, e a espada do Espírito, que é a palavra de Deus;
verses.en_web: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
verses.en_bbe: And take salvation for your head-dress and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

verses.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.pt: orando em todo tempo com toda oração e súplica no Espírito, e vigiando nisso com toda perseverança e súplica por todos os santos,
verses.en_web: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:
verses.en_bbe: With prayers and deep desires, making requests at all times in the Spirit, and keeping watch, with strong purpose, in prayer for all the saints,

verses.en: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.pt: e por mim; a fim de que, quando eu abrir a boca, me seja dada palavra com ousadia, para tornar conhecido o mistério do evangelho,
verses.en_web: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
verses.en_bbe: And for me, that words may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make clear without fear the secret of the good news,

verses.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.pt: pelo qual sou embaixador acorrentado; para que dele eu possa falar com ousadia, como devo falar.
verses.en_web: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.en_bbe: For which I am a representative in chains, and that I may say without fear the things which it is right for me to say.

verses.en: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.pt: Para que também vós possais saber o que acontece comigo, e o que eu faço, Tíquico, o irmão amado, e fiel servidor do Senhor vos informará de tudo.
verses.en_web: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;
verses.en_bbe: But so that you may have knowledge of my business, and how I am, Tychicus, the well-loved brother and tested servant in the Lord, will give you news of all things:

verses.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
verses.pt: Eu o enviei até vós para isso, para que saibais o que acontece conosco, e ele conforte os vossos corações.
verses.en_web: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.
verses.en_bbe: Whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, so that you may have knowledge of our position, and that he may give comfort to your hearts.

verses.en: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Paz seja com os irmãos, e amor com fé, da parte de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça seja com todos os que amam ao nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo com amor que não falha. Amém! Escrita de Roma para os efésios, e enviada por Tíquico
verses.en_web: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Grace be with all those who have true love for our Lord Jesus Christ.
